03/ 10.07.2025 Heard the parties.
2.

This anticipatory bail application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, has been preferred by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Dumri P.S. Case No.08 of 2025, for offences under Sections 406, 409 and 420 IPC.
The case is presently pending before the Court of learned J.M. 1st Class, Gumla.

3. Learned counsel representing the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a Computer Operator at Palkot, and the entire occurrence had taken place in Dumri Block, thus, he cannot be made an accused in this case.

4. Learned Spl. P.P. representing the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail and submits that the petitioner is involved in the conspiracy and has conspired along with others and has divulged the Bank Account and was using the digital dongle through which the embezzlement had taken place.
5. After hearing the parties, I find that as per the F.I.R., there is an allegation of embezzlement of Government money.
There are several persons involved in the occurrence.
